# MOIZ.UX

> Websites That Give Your Brand a Stronger Online Presence.

MOIZ.UX is the personal web development portfolio and service business of Moiz. He builds modern landing pages, business websites, and functional web applications for small businesses, startups, creators, and independent brands.

## Core Message
Your brand deserves more than a social media profile. Give it a home on the web.

## Services
- [Landing Pages](https://moiz-ux.vercel.app/#services): Focused single-page experiences for brands, products, and campaigns. Includes hero sections, features, FAQs, and responsive layouts.
- [Business & Portfolio Websites](https://moiz-ux.vercel.app/#services): Multi-page brand homes for businesses and creators. Includes about pages, service pages, project showcases, and contact forms.
- [Functional Websites](https://moiz-ux.vercel.app/#services): Beyond static content. Includes contact forms, database-backed content, dynamic listings, and third-party integrations.

## Development Process
1. [Discovery](https://moiz-ux.vercel.app/#process): Understand the business, audience, and requirements.
2. [Planning](https://moiz-ux.vercel.app/#process): Agree on scope, content, timeline, and budget.
3. [Development](https://moiz-ux.vercel.app/#process): Build the agreed website and functionality.
4. [Review](https://moiz-ux.vercel.app/#process): Test the website and collect feedback.
5. [Launch](https://moiz-ux.vercel.app/#process): Deploy the approved website and hand over.
